dedupe_keys.name: multinational time use study mtus and uk time use survey 2014 15

description: The Multinational Time Use Study brings together more than a million diary days from over 100 randomly sampled national time use surveys into one standardised format, covering about 55 years and 30 countries, so that researchers can compare time spent in paid and unpaid work, leisure and other activities. It began in the mid-1980s as a dataset with common background variables and daily totals for 41 activities, and now offers harmonised episode and context information, including recent data from the Harmonised European Time Use Survey and the American Time Use Survey. The Centre for Time Use Research also hosts the UK Time Use Survey 2014-15 on the same pages, and with IPUMS provides the MTUS-X extract builder. Coverage: about 30 countries over 55 years. Access: free registration and download of data files with a user guide, restricted-level data on application, and MTUS-X extracts. Licence: CTUR terms on registration; free. Caveats: an upgrade of MTUS is under way that removes some variables and adds others, and survey designs differ between countries and years. Simulation uses are occupancy and activity profiles for building energy, anthropogenic heat and agent-based models in many countries. Related records: the American Time Use Survey and the urbisphere London inputs built from the UK Time Use Survey.
